title: Is Silver Ready to Steal the Spotlight Again?  | Presented by CME Group
description:
Silver rallied sharply in August as demand from solar, semiconductors and AI data centers added to a global supply shortage. Now confronted by key technical resistance levels, what key macroeconomic indicators could determine whether silver’s surge has further to run? Presented by @cmegroup
